rv.q: Mark Babych directs a pacy production, with Biddle's music linking the whole thing together perfectly.
This unsanctimonious entertainment carries a powerful moral message.
Hull Truck Theatre’s Christmas production of Oliver Twist earns considered praise, delivering an experience that is thoughtful, competently assembled, and at times genuinely affecting.
Still, as a straightforward Christmas show, this will do just fine.
The highest praise I can offer is that it takes the best of both, producing a truly memorable and thoroughly uplifting experience.
It’s funny, poignant, covers some quite harrowing subjects sensitively and deserves every accolade it will no doubt get.

cn.t: Hull Truck's Oliver Twist earns mostly strong reviews for its daringly dark yet festive take on Dickens. McAndrew's adaptation and the cast's performances draw wide praise, though it struggles to escape the shadow of the iconic Lionel Bart musical.
